006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.function.Supplier;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
012import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
013import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
014import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFlagDefinition;
015import dev.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * A set of constraints targeting a {@link IFieldDefinition} based on a target
020 * Metapath expression.
021 */
022public class FieldTargetedConstraints
023    extends AbstractTargetedConstraints<IValueConstrained> {
024
025  /**
026   * Construct a new set of targeted constraints.
027   *
028   * @param source
029   *          information about the resource the constraints were sources from
030   * @param targets
031   *          a supplier to get the Metapath expressions that can be used to find
032   *          matching targets
033   * @param constraints
034   *          the constraints to apply to matching targets
035   */
036  public FieldTargetedConstraints(
037      @NonNull ISource source,
038      @NonNull Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets,
039      @NonNull IValueConstrained constraints) {
040    super(source, targets, constraints);
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  public void target(@NonNull IFlagDefinition definition) {
045    wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(definition);
046  }
047
048  @Override
049  public void target(@NonNull IFieldDefinition definition) {
050    applyTo(definition);
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public void target(@NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition) {
055    wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(definition);
056  }
057}
